title: Refund Policy
text: Refund requests must include the order ID, customer email and purchase date. Refunds over 500 USD require manager approval and a fraud review before payment is issued.

title: Security Policy
text: Employees must not paste customer CPF, SSN, credit card numbers or authentication tokens into AI tools. Sensitive information must be redacted before automated processing.

title: Support SLA
text: Enterprise customers receive first response within 2 business hours for high priority support tickets. Normal priority tickets receive first response within 1 business day.
